services.name: Fishing For
services.desc: Many inshore, saltwater fish live in bays, bayous, and grass flats. Along the inter-coastal waterway, bull minnows, pin fish, ale-wives (LY’s), and white shrimp spawn and live in the grass flats. These bait fish and shrimp are natural forage for inshore species. They are commonly used as live bait for black drum, flounder, red fish, sheepshead, and speckled trout. Inshore charters are fun, action packed, and great for the entire family! During fishing trips and cruises, we often encounter dolphins, sea turltes, and other amazing sea life. Don’t forget to bring your camera! We are going to make it an inshore fishing trip to remember! Sabine Marina Pensacola Beach 715 Pensacola Beach Blvd.

blurb: Captain Tony Eddins offers fishing charters in Pensacola Bay and nearby waters targeting species like redfish, speckled trout, flounder, and red snapper. The boat is a 22 ft Pathfinder center console with a 150HP Yamaha engine and equipped with trolling motor, poling platform, Raymarine electronics, and Penn fishing gear. Trips are family friendly and include all necessary gear for fishing.
